class: a conductor turn that ends on an API error, such as a provider rate limit, for which the host runs no Stop hook, so the run sits idle with nothing watching it
caught_by: the plugin registers StopFailure on the Stop hook's script: for a live run the session owns, it records stop_failure in the lease and notifies the operator at once (a macOS notification by default on darwin; ORCHESTRATOR_NOTIFY names another notifier or, at 0, none), and run-state.cjs watch reports the same failure until the conductor writes again
missed_by: the Stop hook, which the host never runs for a failed turn, and run-state.cjs watch, which nothing ran

cost.source: not yet measured; first real run
